New adversarial test file 1: packages/backend/src/modules/company-identity/__tests__/finance-task3-adversarial.test.ts (849 lines, 19 tests). Header documents the targeted gaps (A1-A5, C, D) and the falsifiers. Uses injected fakes for the authenticator/audit/role-policy/attestor-binding/stores; never inspects source text.

A-boundary adversarial cases (3 tests): (i) authentication-failed secret-safe audit — vi.fn authenticator throws; result rejects with COMPANY_IDENTITY_FINANCE_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED; exactly one audit event recorded with outcome=failed, reason=authentication-failed, actor={kind:unauthenticated}; JSON.stringify of the recorded event must not contain the credential value 'sensitive-token-value-must-not-appear-in-audit'. (ii) audit-call-count + deep immutability — single attest call produces exactly one event; Object.isFrozen(event)===true; mutation of reason/scope throws TypeError. (iii) empty appRoleIds with subject+organization match denies with reason=role-not-accepted and actor=authenticated-owner(subjectId).

C-boundary adversarial cases (4 tests): (i) non-UUID jobId from durable result rejects with FINANCE_DURABLE_OUTCOME_INVALID and never binds a receipt. (ii) corrupt stored receipt (extra unapproved key) rejects with FINANCE_OUTBOX_RECEIPT_INVALID, never enqueues, never binds. (iii) idempotency-key version tag + length-prefix invariant — every segment after the version prefix is either school=none or matches /^[a-z-]+=(?:some:\d+:.+|\d+:.+)$/u; the version tag is exactly 'historical-private-evidence-outbox-v1|'. (iv) result/receipt deep-freeze — Object.isFrozen on result, receipt, and each receipt field; mutation throws TypeError.

D-boundary adversarial cases (5+1+1+1+1 tests): (i) it.each for extra envelope fields (authorization, evidence, binding, result, packetDigest) — every extra field rejects with FINANCE_COMMAND_INPUT_INVALID and never calls attest or verify. (ii) result-envelope deep-freeze on packet, authorizationEvidence, and evidence objects; mutation throws TypeError. (iii) packet unchanged-by-value — JSON of returned packet equals JSON of input packet. (iv) fact-array boundary (0/1/128/129) — empty facts rejects with FINANCE_PACKET_INVALID; 1 fact and 128 facts are accepted and reach attest+verify; 129 facts rejects with FINANCE_PACKET_INVALID. (v) attestor evidence strictObject with empty appRoleIds rejects with FINANCE_ATTESTATION_INVALID before any binding call.

New adversarial test file 2: packages/storage/src/__tests__/finance-task3-adversarial.test.ts (255 lines, 10 tests). Header documents the targeted B-boundary gaps and falsifiers. Uses the real createAuthorizedPrivateEvidenceReader over injected fakes.

B-boundary adversarial cases (10 tests): (i) maxBytes-1 acceptance (63 bytes into a 64-byte bound succeeds, contentLength=63). (ii) maxBytes+1 rejection (65 bytes into a 64-byte bound rejects with PRIVATE_EVIDENCE_CONTENT_TOO_LARGE; digest never called). (iii) empty payload acceptance (0 bytes succeeds when expected digest equals the empty-SHA-256 hex). (iv) driver-throw propagation (Error('driver dependency unavailable') propagates; digest never called). (v) byte-copy isolation (mutating result.bytes never mutates the source Uint8Array). (vi) AbortSignal forwarding (the exact controller.signal is passed to driver.read). (vii) signal-aborted driver throw propagates with 'driver read aborted by signal'. (viii) provider-metadata stripping (Object.keys(result) === ['bytes','evidenceReference','metadata','payloadDigest']; JSON.stringify(result) excludes 'internalBucket' and 'provider.example.invalid'). (ix) deny authorize decision rejects with PRIVATE_EVIDENCE_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED and never reaches read or digest. (x) content-type passthrough (text/plain is preserved in metadata.contentType).

Existing finance-private-evidence-read.red.test.ts (25 tests) and finance-authorization-adapter.red.test.ts (7 tests), protocol-safety.red.test.ts (13 tests), durable-job-adapter.red.test.ts (9 tests), historical-private-evidence-packet.red.test.ts (39 tests) all continue to pass on the new commit.
